comparison_role: Task1 matched Real-data budget paired real evaluation

per_trial: pre-action canonical frame and nominal pose
reporting: paired Real96 minus Real48 success difference

next_hardware_gate: Stop before Follower 12 V; wait for separate research-control hardware GO.

placement_contract.task_grid: existing 10 mm visual grid over the frozen 5 cm cells
placement_contract.yaw_0: cube edges parallel to task-grid lines
placement_contract.yaw_45: cube rotated nominally 45 degrees about its center
